description: Book a bareboat boat rental. A boat with Instant Book on returns a Stripe Checkout link (payment.kind checkout_link) for the charterer to complete payment. For a boat whose owner reviews every request first (get_quote's instantBook: false), a request is sent instead: nothing is charged, the result is a request with the estimated total and deposit, and if the owner accepts, the charterer is emailed a link to pay. Requires captainChoiceRightAcknowledged: true (the charterer affirms their right to choose their own captain). Optionally attach a partner/affiliate code; partnerCode can't be used on a request (PARTNER_CODE_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_REQUESTS).
name: create_boat_rental
title: Create Boat Rental
